review_scope: Read-only cached-source identity and category audit; no network requests, no raw/processed data writes and no implementation changes.

method.grouping: Exact normalized primary name only; does not use aliases, localized names, fuzzy similarity, phone, address or category to generate pairs.
method.name_normalization: Unicode NFKC → casefold → ё replaced by е → re.sub(r"[^\w]+", "", name).
method.distance: Haversine on source POI lat/lon; Earth radius 6371008.8 m; retain unrounded distance <50 m. Display distances rounded to 3 decimals.
method.phone_review_normalization: For evidence display only: split semicolon/comma values, strip nondigits; normalize an 11-digit leading 8 to 7. Shared chain numbers do not establish branch identity. No production matching rule is changed.

decision_policy: A duplicate candidate is not a proven duplicate.
Only the three already-approved after_enrichment source-ID/target-ID rules are accepted as new merges in this implementation batch.
All other candidates remain unchanged pending explicit reviewed evidence; high priority is not merge authorization.
Preserve conflicting addresses, hours, phones, source URLs, collection/source dates and every source ID.
Do not merge tenant, host mall, event, building, branch or park scopes solely because names or coordinates coincide.
Source classification flags express uncertainty; they do not prove wrong categories or false business names.
